d:
Daler Mehndi's 'Shaman Paiyan' is the track from his album 'Mojaan Laen Do' which was released in the year 2003. Sufi in character, the song has signature Daler Mehndi energy, verve, colors and his amazing costumes all designed by him.
Year Of Release : 2003
Title : Mojaan Laen Do
Song : Shama Paiyan
Album : Mojaan Laen Do
Artist : Daler Mehndi
Lyricist : Daler Mehndi
Music Director : Daler Mehndi & Ravi Pawar
